method: Each object was photographed in the viewer from its best view, its box drawn on the image, and judged by eye by a coding agent (not a person) on contact sheets, with its description as extra evidence. Pipes, cables and hoses whose description agreed were skipped. Only clear mistakes are corrected; 'object' means the type couldn't be told.
